scope: Initial exact Wan TI2V-5B and MiniMax FL2VA T2V baselines only. Remaining video capabilities remain unverified. No READY or Full Factory E2E.

request.prompt: A single bright red ball rolling from the left side toward the right across a plain white table. Static locked camera, wide shot, realistic photograph, clear smooth horizontal movement. No other objects.
request.negative_prompt: static image, still photo, blue car, dog, text, watermark

expected.positive_text: a video frame of a red ball on a white table
negative_texts: a photograph of a blue car
a photograph of a green tree
a photograph of a black dog
